transkript.t: This might be one of the most premium UI libraries
I've ever came across.
It's called Kitchen, and the name fits
because the details on these are crazy.
There's a cassette player of rules that actually turn.
Text that scrambles into place.
The delete button you have to hold down
so no one hits it by mistake.
And my top pick, a checkout that prints a little receipt
the second a payment goes through.
These are the tiny moments that make a site feel
high-end, and most sites don't even bother.
A lot of kits this polished cost money.
This one is free to look through,
and the code is right there on each page.
So just copy it and paste it into your project.
Or if you've never touched code,
you hand it to Claude and say, add this to my site.
It's made by a design engineer called JP.
You can tell he cares about the tiny details.
I'd still do a receipt for the next checkout page I build
because people will screenshot that and share it to people.
Comment kits, and I'll send you the full library.
